responsibilities.responsibility: Maintain source-neutral typed child destinations and actor-scoped lifecycle state for topics, SavedSublist histories, and nested/community conversations; validate pagination windows, monotonic read state, pin/active/unread/no-paid policy, exact-child destruction, membership authorization, and SyncBatch projection.
responsibilities.visible_effect: Child chat/topic/saved-sublist state survives sync and lifecycle operations without silently falling back to the parent conversation.
failure_behavior: SavedSublist non-self parent fails closed until source-neutral monoforum relation exists
responsibilities.cancellation_behavior: Source merge identifies request cancellation/retry for child history loading as still separate/open responsibility; do not invent successful cancellation semantics here.
responsibilities.retry_semantics: No blind replay of side-effecting lifecycle commands; preserve stable command identity when wired through Android Coordinator.
responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: Exact repeated state-setting may converge, but destroy/pagination/recovery still require durable command identity and reconciliation at Android wiring.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Must restore the same persisted child runtime state from the canonical Rust repository; UI recreation must not recreate or mutate canonical child truth.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Every projection/mutation must remain actor/account scoped and stale-account callbacks must be rejected by Coordinator epoch.
responsibilities.security_boundary: Membership/owner/community authorization is checked by Host/service before canonical child mutation.
responsibilities.android_owner: Rust AndroidMessagingService canonical repository under Host, delegating actor-scoped child runtime state to ConversationChildStore; no Compose/ViewModel canonical owner
responsibilities.platform_delta: Core state machine is platform-independent Rust-to-Rust. Android lifecycle adds process-death recovery and typed JNI projection; no Kotlin duplicate owner.
responsibilities.production_wiring: implemented: feature.messaging.access.issue resolves the current authenticated account actor in Host; feature.messaging.execute routes protocol v2 envelopes into AndroidMessagingService, which owns actors/conversations/messages, validates canonical membership/message proof, and delegates child state to ConversationChildStore. Unsupported messaging commands fail closed rather than returning placeholder success.

responsibilities.contract_test: implemented in Rust source for authenticated-actor fencing, parent/nested membership proof, topic root/message-child proof, SavedSublist self-parent fail-closed, SyncBatch actor filtering; exact-head CI pending
responsibilities.integration_test: production Host ingress now implemented through existing Coordinator/JNI dispatch; same-head CI and packaged/device evidence pending
responsibilities.device_test: required: child destination lifecycle survives Activity recreation/process kill without duplicate mutation
responsibilities.notes: Canonical membership/message proof and production Host ingress are now implemented without accepting client-supplied authorization truth. This remains not-verified until exact-head Rust/architecture/package/device evidence succeeds; unsupported broader messaging commands remain explicit migration work.

responsibilities.responsibility: Own durable Fabushi account session lifecycle, same-origin browser login, session normalization, identity settlement, coordinated refresh, logout/revocation, and valid bearer delivery to production Host inference without exposing credentials to presentation.
responsibilities.state_owner: Rust Host account service; Android Keystore is storage resource only; Compose/ViewModel never owns tokens
responsibilities.visible_effect: Normal production login settles to the same Fabushi account, survives process death, and supplies production Agent inference with a refreshed account bearer without CI-only session injection.
failure_behavior: expired refreshless production session becomes signed-out
responsibilities.cancellation_behavior: Browser cancel consumes current attempt and best-effort cancels backend attempt; stale attempt ids are rejected.
responsibilities.retry_semantics: Refresh has one process Host owner; no UI retry owner. Side-effecting logout is best-effort after local revocation. Browser poll is explicit and bounded by attempt expiry.
responsibilities.idempotency_semantics: Persisted session replacement is atomic; auth callback/poll is bound to attempt id; refresh must preserve device/user identity.
responsibilities.process_death_recovery: Android Keystore AES-GCM protects the serialized session; ciphertext lives in noBackupFilesDir; process-owned MahayanaHost injects decrypted session only into native Host at creation.
responsibilities.account_fencing: Account/session owner remains behind Coordinator/Host; follow-up work must bind account epoch to all callbacks before verified status.
responsibilities.security_boundary: AndroidKeyStore key never leaves platform; secret mutation is consumed inside MahayanaHost and removed before Presentation; public release CI import remains separately compile-gated.
responsibilities.android_owner: Rust AndroidAccountService behind Coordinator/Host; Keystore adapter owns encryption/storage mechanics only
responsibilities.platform_delta: Desktop secret-store + host credential file becomes AndroidKeyStore AES-GCM + no-backup ciphertext, with initial session injected through the typed native boundary and private persistence mutations consumed before UI.
